name: Two Nights Universe
overview:
This Thai anthology series explicitly centers on Girls' Love (GL) romances, compiling six distinct, interconnected love stories between women (such as Two Nights With My Boss or Two Nights With The Devil) using a 5-minute vertical format. Related Content
